Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Critical for high-strength, lightweight parts particularly in load-bearing components; offers corrosion resistance and fatigue strength essential for structural integrity.

Aircraft Structural Integrity Components.reasoning: Used for high-strength components such as fasteners and critical structural areas needing increased hardness; standard aerospace steel type.
